description: Basel Info ÖV-Linien is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Basel-Stadt. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
